brokerMetrics.title: Broker Metrics
brokerMetrics.description: The Kafka Broker metrics here inform you of data loss/delay through unclean leader elections and network throughputs, as well as request fails through request purgatories and timeouts metrics

consumerMetrics.title: Consumer Metrics
consumerMetrics.description: Kafka Consumer metrics provide insights into lag between message production and consumption, success rates and latency of message delivery, and the volume of data consumed.

producerMetrics.title: Producer Metrics
producerMetrics.description: Kafka Producers send messages to brokers for storage and distribution by topic. These metrics inform you of the volume and rate of data sent, and the success rate of message delivery.

brokerJVMMetrics.title: Broker JVM Metrics
brokerJVMMetrics.description: Kafka brokers are Java applications that expose JVM metrics to inform on the broker's system health. Garbage collection metrics like those below provide key insights into free memory, broker performance, and heap size. You need to enable new_gc_metrics for this section to populate.

partitionMetrics.title: Partition Metrics
partitionMetrics.description: Kafka partitions are the unit of parallelism in Kafka. These metrics inform you of the number of partitions per topic, the current offset of each partition, the oldest offset, and the number of in-sync replicas.

metric_page.request_times_desc: This metric is used to measure the average latency experienced by requests across the Kafka broker.
metric_page.broker_count_desc: Total number of active brokers in the Kafka cluster.
metric_page.producer_fetch_request_purgatory_desc: Measures the number of requests that Kafka brokers have received but cannot immediately fulfill
metric_page.broker_network_throughput_desc: Helps gauge the data throughput from the Kafka broker to consumer clients, focusing on the network usage associated with serving messages to consumers.
metric_page.io_wait_time_desc: This metric measures the total time that producers are in an I/O wait state, indicating potential bottlenecks in data transmission from producers to Kafka brokers.
metric_page.request_response_rate_desc: Indicates how many requests the producer is sending per second, reflecting the intensity of the producer's interaction with the Kafka cluster. Also, helps Kafka administrators gauge the responsiveness of brokers to producer requests.
metric_page.avg_request_latency_desc: Helps Kafka administrators and developers understand the average latency experienced by producer requests.
metric_page.producer_byte_rate_desc: Helps measure the data output rate from the producer, indicating the load a producer is placing on Kafka brokers.
metric_page.bytes_consumed_desc: Helps Kafka administrators monitor the data consumption rate of a consumer group, showing how much data (in bytes) is being read from the Kafka cluster over time.
metric_page.consumer_offset_desc: Current offset of each consumer group for each topic partition
metric_page.consumer_group_members_desc: Number of active users in each group
metric_page.consumer_lag_by_group_desc: Helps Kafka administrators assess whether consumer groups are keeping up with the incoming data stream or falling behind
metric_page.consumer_fetch_rate_desc: Metric measures the rate at which fetch requests are made by a Kafka consumer to the broker, typically in requests per second.
metric_page.messages_consumed_desc: Measures the rate at which a Kafka consumer is consuming records (messages) per second from Kafka brokers.
metric_page.jvm_gc_count_desc: Tracks the total number of garbage collection (GC) events that have occurred in the Java Virtual Machine (JVM).
metric_page.jvm_gc_elapsed_desc: Measures the total time (usually in milliseconds) spent on garbage collection (GC) events in the Java Virtual Machine (JVM).
metric_page.cpu_recent_utilization_desc: This metric measures the recent CPU usage by the Java Virtual Machine (JVM), typically expressed as a percentage.
metric_page.jvm_memory_heap_desc: The metric represents the maximum amount of heap memory available to the Java Virtual Machine (JVM)
metric_page.partition_count_per_topic_desc: Number of partitions for each topic
metric_page.current_offset_partition_desc: Current offset of each partition, showing the latest position in each partition
metric_page.oldest_offset_partition_desc: Oldest offset of each partition to identify log retention and offset range.
metric_page.insync_replicas_desc: Count of in-sync replicas for each partition to ensure data availability.
